Scenario: You are awakened in the middle of the night by the sound of footsteps alongside your bed.

Scenario: While resting peacefully in your bed, you begin to sense a slight tug on the back of your hair, then you feel it again.
Log Version: I felt something tugging at my hair.

Scenario: While home alone, you hear the bathroom door slam so hard it rattles the glassware in your kitchen.

Scenario: You're taking the trash bin out to the street before going to bed for the night. Just as you approach the curb, you notice a child's silhouette peering at you from your bedroom window. You blink, and the shadow vanishes.
Log Version: I observed a strange silhouette in my bedroom window.

Scenario: You wake up early one morning to discover all the drawers in your room have been pulled out. The clothes are untouched, and nothing else seems out of place.
Log Version: Somebody, or something, meddled with my bedroom drawers while I was sleeping.

Scenario: While home alone, you begin to sing one of your favorite songs by <musician>, loudly and without shame. During a slight pause, you hear a voice singing along softly from another room.

Scenario: While heading to bed after your nightly routine, you sense an icy chill running up the back of your back. Your hair follicles sharpen as the room gets noticeably colder.
Log Version: I experienced an odd, chilling sensation while heading to bed.

Scenario: You awake without cause in the middle of the night to a dark shadow darting across your bedroom.
Log Version: I saw an eerie shadow in my bedroom.

Scenario: An overwhelming, putrid odor quickly wafts through your home. It happens every time you are home alone then vanishes suddenly.

Scenario: While entering your bedroom from the hallway, you witness a glowing orb of light, it floats across the room and disappears inside the closet.

Scenario: You notice that someone has been shuffling around the trinkets that embellish your room, ever so slightly. Upon returning home alone one night, you find your room more rearranged than ever, despite having locked the door.

Scenario: You're working tirelessly on a 5,000 piece puzzle when, through the patio door, you spot something peculiar in the backyard. You stand up to witness a pile of leaves and sticks levitating about four feet in the air, petrifying still.
